We spent a lovely weekend in Swallow cottage. Just perfect for a group of friends looking for some time in the country to relax and catch up. We arrived to a very warm welcome from Liz and were shown to our cottage which was comfy, clean and tidy. Cottages are located on a working farm and the games room was a great place to relax and play a few games! Highly recommend to anyone looking for a break away from busy life – fantastic location, charming cottages and friendly owners!

Stayed here for 2 nights as husband had a course nearby and we chose this for convenience. The property is dog friendly and lots of grounds to explore. [/et_pb_testimonial][et_pb_testimonial author=”Alex Smith” portrait_url=”https://blacohillcottages.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/2020/09/Screenshot-2020-09-16-at-11.48.38.png” quote_icon=”off” portrait_width=”60px” portrait_height=”60px” _builder_version=”4.5.7″ body_font=”||on||||||” body_font_size=”15px” body_letter_spacing=”0.5px” body_line_height=”1.4em” use_background_color=”off” background_layout=”dark” max_width=”600px” module_alignment=”center” custom_margin=”|||” custom_margin_tablet=”|40px||40px||true” custom_margin_last_edited=”off|desktop” locked=”off”]

  • Leave at junction 34, on A614 Bawtry.
  • In Bawtry at the traffic lights turn left for Gainsborough A631.
  • In the village of Eveton take a right turn by The Sun Inn to Mattersey.
  • In the village of Mattersey take the first left past the post office signposted Sutton cum Sound.
  • Follow the road out of the village for half a mile.
  • Blaco Hill Farm Cottages is on the left hand side before the hill.

  • Leave at the junction signed Retford A620 and turn left for Retford.

Our website uses cookies. Cookies are small text files that are placed on your computer or device when you visit our website

We’ve listed the cookies we use below with details about the type of cookie they are, why we use them, and if applicable how long they last.

Our website uses both session cookies and persistent cookies. Session cookies enable any information you have entered to be remembered when you move from page to page within our website, but are deleted when you close your browser or after a short time. Persistent cookies allow our website to remember your preferences and settings when you visit our website in the future; they expire after a set period of time.

Our site uses first party cookies (i.e. they are set by our website) and third party cookies (i.e. they are set by one of our service providers).

We do not share any information that can be used to identify you personally with these third parties.

Access statement for Blaco Hill Farm Cottages

Our 7 self catering cottages have been converted from disused farm buildings, on a working arable farm. The cottages are set around a shared courtyard and carpark. We have tried to provide as much information as possible in this statement, if you have any queries please do call.

We look forwarding to welcoming you.

We have a no smoking policy in all our cottages

  • We are 4* rated with Visit Britain
  • We are listed on booking.com & groupaccommodation.com 
  • Bookings/enquiries can be made via email or phone.
  • The nearest bus stop is at the bottom of the farm drive.
  • The nearest train station is 5 miles away in Retford.
  • We have wireless internet access

  • Car park and path surface is small pea gravel over tarmac or concrete base.

  • sideboard

  • Tiled flooring, 1 rug.
  • Electric fire.
  • 2 lamps
  • Digital TV & DVD Player Cd player

    wardrobe

  • Transfer space LH 60cm, Middle 65cm, RH 52cm

Perfect for families

Cuckoo is an idyllic place for a holiday in the country, and perfect for families with young children. Set in our beautiful courtyard, Cuckoo sleeps 4 and has been sensitively renovated to make to most of its original charm. Please note this property is accessed up a set of steps.

Perfect for families

Set over two floors Chaffinch is well equipped with all modern conveniences offering a superb ‘home from home’ stay. about

Blaco Hill Cottages

We are a family run business, offering a selection of 12 self catering properties on our working farm on the North Nottinghamshire, South Yorkshire border. From converted courtyard barns to old pigstys and stables each property is unique in character. Our selection of self-catering accommodation is fully equipped with everything that you will need during your stay.

[/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][/et_pb_row][et_pb_row column_structure=”1_2,1_2″ _builder_version=”4.5.7″ _module_preset=”default”][et_pb_column type=”1_2″ _builder_version=”4.5.7″ _module_preset=”default”][et_pb_text _builder_version=”4.5.7″ _module_preset=”default”]

Blaco Hill Farm was acquired by the Lee Family in the 1950’s and we are now in the 4th Generation. Originally farming both arable and livestock the farm saw herds of Lincoln Red cows and flocks of Poll Dorset sheep in its fields along with Pigs and Turkeys. We now have a succler herd of Hereford cows, with calves in April and May, that can be seen on fields around the lakes throughout the summer or tucked up in cosy straw barns during the colder winter months.

 

[/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][et_pb_column type=”1_2″ _builder_version=”4.5.7″ _module_preset=”default”][et_pb_text _builder_version=”4.5.7″ _module_preset=”default”]

We now farm a large area of arable crops that include potatoes, carrots, sugarbeet, maize and cereals that you will find in many popular brands in the supermarkets.

The cottages were developed in the early 2000s when the farm needed more space due to the ever increasing size of machinery and relocated to buildings on another part of the farm. The cottages have been sympathetically converted to retain many of the original windows and beams giving them a cosy rustic feel.

Are your properties suitable for me?” closed_toggle_background_color=”#f5f5f5″ icon_color=”#00a86b” _builder_version=”4.5.7″ title_font=”|700|||||||” title_line_height=”1.4em” body_font=”||||||||” body_line_height=”1.4em” border_width_all=”2px” border_color_all=”#f5f5f5″ locked=”off”]

We do everything we can to accommodate everyone. Please read our access statement for further details.

[/et_pb_toggle][et_pb_toggle title=”Do you have any laundry facilities we can use?” closed_toggle_background_color=”#f5f5f5″ icon_color=”#00a86b” _builder_version=”4.5.7″ title_font=”|700|||||||” title_line_height=”1.4em” body_font=”||||||||” body_line_height=”1.4em” border_width_all=”2px” border_color_all=”#f5f5f5″ locked=”off”]

There is a communal laundry room which guests are welcome to use. It includes 2 washing machines, a tumble dryer and ironing equipment.

[/et_pb_toggle][/et_pb_column][et_pb_column type=”1_2″ _builder_version=”3.25″ custom_padding=”|||” custom_padding__hover=”|||”][et_pb_toggle title=”Do you accept pets?” closed_toggle_background_color=”#f5f5f5″ icon_color=”#00a86b” _builder_version=”4.5.7″ title_font=”|700|||||||” title_line_height=”1.4em” body_font=”||||||||” body_line_height=”1.4em” border_width_all=”2px” border_color_all=”#f5f5f5″ locked=”off”]

We are happy to accept pets in some of our holiday cottages.

[/et_pb_toggle][et_pb_toggle title=”What time can I check in on arrival and what time do I have to vacate the property by on my departure?” closed_toggle_background_color=”#f5f5f5″ icon_color=”#00a86b” _builder_version=”4.5.7″ title_font=”|700|||||||” title_line_height=”1.4em” body_font=”||||||||” body_line_height=”1.4em” border_width_all=”2px” border_color_all=”#f5f5f5″ locked=”off”]

Cottages are available from 3pm on the day of arrival and we ask that guests vacate by 10am on the day of departure. We can be flexible so please let us know if you have different requirements.

[/et_pb_toggle][et_pb_toggle title=”Do you have wifi?” closed_toggle_background_color=”#f5f5f5″ icon_color=”#00a86b” _builder_version=”4.5.7″ title_font=”|700|||||||” title_line_height=”1.4em” body_font=”||||||||” body_line_height=”1.4em” border_width_all=”2px” border_color_all=”#f5f5f5″ locked=”off”]Yes! We have wifi in all properties and in our Games Room. And signal is also good when outside.[/et_pb_toggle][et_pb_toggle title=”Are your cottages child friendly?” closed_toggle_background_color=”#f5f5f5″ icon_color=”#00a86b” _builder_version=”4.5.7″ title_font=”|700|||||||” title_line_height=”1.4em” body_font=”||||||||” body_line_height=”1.4em” border_width_all=”2px” border_color_all=”#f5f5f5″ locked=”off”]Yes, growing up at Blaco ad now having children of our own we know how important this is. Stair gates, Ikea highchairs and travel cots can all be requested free of charge and we have plenty of open space to run around, with a woodland children play area and indoor games room with a selection of toys and games for all ages. [/et_pb_toggle][et_pb_toggle title=”Where should I park?” closed_toggle_background_color=”#f5f5f5″ icon_color=”#00a86b” _builder_version=”4.5.7″ title_font=”|700|||||||” title_line_height=”1.4em” body_font=”||||||||” body_line_height=”1.4em” border_width_all=”2px” border_color_all=”#f5f5f5″ locked=”off”]We have a designated carpark for the cottages with some under cover parking close to all the cottages. [/et_pb_toggle][et_pb_toggle title=”What length of stays do you offer?” closed_toggle_background_color=”#f5f5f5″ icon_color=”#00a86b” _builder_version=”4.5.7″ title_font=”|700|||||||” title_line_height=”1.4em” body_font=”||||||||” body_line_height=”1.4em” border_width_all=”2px” border_color_all=”#f5f5f5″ locked=”off”]

We are completely flexible with length of stays, from one night to long term lets we can offer accommodation to meet your needs. 

[/et_pb_toggle][et_pb_toggle title=”How do I pay?” closed_toggle_background_color=”#f5f5f5″ icon_color=”#00a86b” _builder_version=”4.5.7″ title_font=”|700|||||||” title_line_height=”1.4em” body_font=”||||||||” body_line_height=”1.4em” border_width_all=”2px” border_color_all=”#f5f5f5″ locked=”off”]

Our preferred method of payment is by bank transfer but we can also take payment by cheques or PayPal. All details will be given in your correspondence with us. 

[/et_pb_toggle][/et_pb_column][/et_pb_row][et_pb_row column_structure=”1_2,1_2″ _builder_version=”3.25″ custom_margin=”40px|||” custom_padding=”60px|||” border_color_all=”#f5f5f5″ border_width_top=”2px” locked=”off”][et_pb_column type=”1_2″ _builder_version=”3.25″ custom_padding=”|||” custom_padding__hover=”|||”][et_pb_blurb title=”Checking in & Checkout Process” _builder_version=”4.5.7″ header_level=”h5″ header_font=”|700|||||||” header_font_size=”20px” header_line_height=”1.2em” body_font=”||||||||” body_line_height=”1.4em” custom_margin=”||10px|”]

  • Self check in is available from 15.00, unless prior arrangements have been agreed otherwise.
  • On day of departure please vacate your cottage by 10.00am leaving the key in the door.
  • Everything you need to know is detailed in your correspondence with us upon booking

[/et_pb_blurb][/et_pb_column][et_pb_column type=”1_2″ _builder_version=”3.25″ custom_padding=”|||” custom_padding__hover=”|||”][et_pb_blurb title=”Cancellation Policy” _builder_version=”4.5.7″ header_level=”h5″ header_font=”|700|||||||” header_font_size=”20px” header_line_height=”1.2em” body_font=”||||||||” body_line_height=”1.4em” custom_margin=”||10px|”]

Any cancellation for whatever reason, except in instances of a force majeure, should be made in writing via email. On receipt of notice of cancellation, Blaco Hill Farm Cottages will seek to re-let the property for the period of booking.

If Blaco Hill Farm Cottages is unable to re-let the property at all then all monies paid by the Client shall be forfeit to Blaco Hill Farm Cottages. Blaco Hill Farm Cottages strongly recommends Clients to take out Cancellation Insurance.

Blaco Hill Farm Cottages are situated on a working farm just outside Mattersey, on the Nottinghamshire and South Yorkshire border.

On the farm itself are three lakes, which have a wide variety of bird life both native and visiting species.

Adjacent to the farm is the Nottinghamshire Wildlife Trusts Idle Valley nature reserve, which is a site of Special Scientific Interest and has a diverse variety of bird & wildlife.

In an area rich with Outdoor Activities that will be fun for all the family. And if the weather is not so good we have a Games Room equipped with a full size snooker table, table tennis and a large comfortable seating area. Please feel free to look around our site.

We do hope you find Blaco Hill a relaxing, care-free environment and hopefully we will have the pleasure of your company in the near future.

We are here for you – to help you plan, organize, and fulfill your dreams of a relaxing, self catering holiday away from all the stresses of everyday life, here in Mattersey.

Privacy Policy

Who we are 

Our website address is: http://www.blacohillcottages.co.uk.

What personal data we collect and why we collect it

Comments
When visitors leave comments on the site we collect the data shown in the comments form, and also the visitor’s IP address and browser user agent string to help spam detection.

An anonymized string created from your email address (also called a hash) may be provided to the Gravatar service to see if you are using it. The Gravatar service privacy policy is available here: https://automattic.com/privacy/. After approval of your comment, your profile picture is visible to the public in the context of your comment.

Media

If you upload images to the website, you should avoid uploading images with embedded location data (EXIF GPS) included. Visitors to the website can download and extract any location data from images on the website.

Contact forms 
Cookies

If you leave a comment on our site you may opt-in to saving your name, email address and website in cookies. These are for your convenience so that you do not have to fill in your details again when you leave another comment. These cookies will last for one year.

If you visit our login page, we will set a temporary cookie to determine if your browser accepts cookies. This cookie contains no personal data and is discarded when you close your browser.

When you log in, we will also set up several cookies to save your login information and your screen display choices. Login cookies last for two days, and screen options cookies last for a year. If you select “Remember Me”, your login will persist for two weeks. If you log out of your account, the login cookies will be removed.

If you edit or publish an article, an additional cookie will be saved in your browser. This cookie includes no personal data and simply indicates the post ID of the article you just edited. It expires after 1 day.

Embedded content from other websites

Articles on this site may include embedded content (e.g. videos, images, articles, etc.). Embedded content from other websites behaves in the exact same way as if the visitor has visited the other website.

These websites may collect data about you, use cookies, embed additional third-party tracking, and monitor your interaction with that embedded content, including tracking your interaction with the embedded content if you have an account and are logged in to that website.

Analytics

This website uses Google Analytics, a web analytics service provided by Google, Inc. (“Google”). Google Analytics uses “cookies”, which are text files placed on your computer to help VFS Global analyze how visitors use the site. The information generated by the cookie about your use of the website (including your IP address) will be transmitted to and stored by Google on servers in the United States. Google will use this information for the purpose of evaluating your use of this website, compiling reports on your website activity for pages visited, the duration and bounce rate, while providing other miscellaneous services relating to website activity and usage. Google may also transfer this information to third parties where required to do so by law, or where such third parties process the information on Google’s behalf. Google will not associate your IP address with any other data held by Google. You may refuse the use of cookies by selecting the appropriate settings on your browser, however please note that if you do this you may not be able to use the full functionality of this website. By using this website, you consent to the processing of data about you by Google in the manner and for the purposes set out above.

You can prevent Google’s cookie generated collection of data, referring to your use of the website (incl. your IP address), plus the processing of the data, by downloading and installing the browser-plugin, which you can find here: https://tools.google.com/dlpage/gaoptout?hl=en-GB

Who we share your data with

We do not share any data you supply to us with third parties.

What rights you have over your data

If you have an account on this site, or have left comments, you can request to receive an exported file of the personal data we hold about you, including any data you have provided to us. You can also request that we erase any personal data we hold about you. This does not include any data we are obliged to keep for administrative, legal, or security purposes.

Where we send your data

Visitor messages may be checked through an automated spam detection service.

Contact Information

Blaco Hill Farm, Mattersey,
Doncaster, South Yorks
DN10 5HQ

Tel: 01777 817254

Email: enquiries@blacohillcottages.co.uk
